scope: Current shared-root link generation, supported graph URL parameters, declaration identity, and focused regression assertions only. No mathematical, source, decoder or semantic-binding rereview.

findings.evidence: library_shelves.py imports urllib.parse.quote and constructs ../../lean-foundations.html?view=lean&focus=<quoted decl:name>&q=<quoted name>, with HTML-escaped ampersands. Evaluating only its current roots assignment and parsing the actual resulting anchor round-trips exactly to the expected view, node identity and query.

underlying-lean-graph.js lines273–275 reads view, q and focus with URLSearchParams. viewKinds.lean includes declaration nodes (line22). The requested focus invokes selectNode(focus,true) when nodes.has(focus). The old search parameter is not used.

selectNode lines244–255 sets state.focus, expands the node, populates the inspector from the node details and rerenders. This verifies code behavior for a present matching node, without claiming a browser click occurred.
Production namespace line17 plus theorem name line26 yields exactly the full name in the link and decl: prefix. This review checks that declaration identity, not generated graph-data membership.

Focused regression assertions at tools/tests/test_astis_publication.py lines299–301 require lean-foundations.html?view=lean&focus=decl%3A, the affine-gradient q parameter, and absence of &search=. The test was inspected, not executed by this reviewer.

remaining_validation: The integration owner will click the actual chapter link and confirm the generated graph contains the focused declaration and opens its inspector. No historical or browser evidence is invented here.
